PROJECT NARRATIVE

The real property that is the subject of the application for a zoning map amendment is 4325 S.
King Drive, Chicago, IL 60653 (‘4325 S. King Drive”). The owner of 4325 S. King Drive is JRD
LLC-4325 (the “Owner-Applicant”). The Owner-Applicant owns the adjacent property commonly
known as 4327 S. King Drive (4327 S. King Drive together with the Subject Property, collectively
herein the “Property”). The Owner-Applicant purchased both properties on August 8, 2024.

The following is a table of information about the Subject Property and Adjacent Property:

4325 S, King Drive 4327 S. King Drive
Land Area 3,760.98 3,444.57
Building Area 7,404 SF (est.) 6,676 SF (est.)
Building Height 46°9” 46-9”
Number of Stories 3 4
Improvements Brick building Brick building
Zoning Classification B3-3 RM-5

The Property is located on one zoning lot (as that term is defined in the Zoning Ordinance) and
one property index number (i.e., 20-03-400-005).

The building on the 4325 S. King Drive and the building on the 4327 S. King Drive are attached
along the center portion of the buildings. The past use of the Property has been multi-unit
residential with no off-street parking.

The Owner-Applicant seeks to rezone the 4325 S. King Drive from B3-3 to RM-S to match the
zoning of the 4327 S. King Drive to rehab the interior of both buildings into 13 residential dwelling
units, Additionally, the Owner-Applicant seeks Administrative Adjustments and Variations needed
per plans prepared by Red Architects dated June 26, 2025, including but not limited to Section 17-
13-1003-EE-1 (Parking Reduction for Transit-Served Locations) and 17-13-1101-B (reduction in
any setback required). The Property is located 1,117’ of the 43" Street Green Line Station and,
thus, is located within the radius of a Transit-Served Location. The total building area of both
buildings is 13,991 SF. New exterior wood porches attached to the rear of the buildings will be
constructed in the same size and location as the existing porch. There will be 13 bike stalls locate
in the rear yard along the southside of the building. There will be a 582 VSQ FT open space in the
rear yard. A new trash enclosure will be located at the northeast corner of the Property in the rear
yard area. There will be no off-street parking. Applicant will seek all relief needed, as allowed by
the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

No changes are proposed to the existing building height. No changes are proposed to expand the
existing building square footage.

The following is the narrative zoning and development analysis for the proposed development on
the Subject Property. The proposed FAR will be 1.94. The maximum FAR in the RM-5 district is
2.0. The proposed density is 13 units. The maximum allowed density is 18 units based on the
minimum lot area of 400 SF per dwelling unit. The Subject Property will not have any off-street
parking. The minimum requirement is 1 space per unit, thus 13 spaces for the proposed 13 units
and 1 bike space per 2 auto spaces, thus 6 bike spaces. However, because the Subject Property is
located within a Transit-Served Location the application seeks an administrative
adjustment reducing off-street parking requirements from the otherwise applicable standards by
more than 50% as expressly authorized in Section 17-10-0102-B. The proposed side setback along
the northern property and the southern property line will be 0°. The minimum is 3.84 feet (i.e.,
20% of Lot Width = 9.6 feet). The application seeks a variation from the minimum side setback
requirement. The proposed front setback will be the existing setback of 2 feet. Because the Subject
Property’s frontage is located on a primary boulevard, as defined in Sec. 17-17-02124 (i.e., 4325
S. King Drive), the minimum is 3.45 feet, which is the average front yard depth that exists on the
nearest 2 lots on either side of subject property (i.e., 4313 S. King Drive [ie., 2.31 feet], 4321 S.
King Drive [ie., 0 feet], 4327 S. King Drive [i-e., 6.27 feet] and 4329 S. King Drive [i.e., 5.22
feet]). The application seeks a variation from the minimum front setback requirement. The rear set
back will be 38.83 feet. The minimum is 45 feet. The application seeks a variation from the
minimum rear setback requirement. The existing building height is 46 feet-9 inches. No changes
are proposed to the existing building height. The maximum building height is 47 feet. The applicant
will seek all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.
